lessons.title: 2. List Comprehensions & `enumerate()`
lessons.description: List comprehensions offer a concise syntax for transforming lists: `[x * 2 for x in lst if x > 0]`. `enumerate(lst, start=1)` yields index and item pairs.
learning_objectives: Build list comprehensions and use enumerate
lessons.solution_code:
def double_evens(numbers):
    return [x * 2 for x in numbers if x % 2 == 0]

lessons.title: 4. Discount Price Applier (Practice)
lessons.description: Apply a percentage discount to all prices in a list using a comprehension: each price is reduced by `discount_pct` percent.
learning_objectives: Apply list comprehensions to price transformations
lessons.solution_code:
def apply_discounts(prices, discount_pct):
    return [p * (1 - discount_pct / 100) for p in prices]

lessons.title: 5. Unit 10 Checkpoint: Loops Mastery
lessons.description: filter_long_words(words, min_len) must return, via a list comprehension, only the words whose length is at least min_len.
lessons.solution_code:
def filter_long_words(words, min_len):
    return [w for w in words if len(w) >= min_len]
